title.narrative: Lonac pro - Collective Impact for Youth, MOZAIK
Lonac pro - Collective Impact for Youth, MOZAIK

description.narrative:
The overall objective during the intervention of 3 years id to strengthen sustainable, country-wide, multi-stakeholder and value -driven ecosystem that provides ongoing and tailor-made opportunities for any young women and men, regardless of their identities or location in succeeding in the social and/or economic sector in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The impact and goal of the intervention will be achieved through three outcomes whereby each outcome has further outputs and respective activities aimed at meeting the overall objective. Three listed outcomes are as follows: 1) strong and lasting partnerships with the local authorities established that directly influence use of available public resources to provide support to young female and male entrepreneurs. 2) Strong ecosystem for start up entrepreneurship and philanthropy is established within the community Lonac.pro with partnerships that create various opportunities for professional success of young women and men. 3) To design and deliver meaningful and tailor-made opportunities for young female and male entrepreneurs to start their own sustainable micro-businesses.
More specifically, expected results such as creation of 300 jobs, implementation of 300 community projects aimed at improving local communities, successful disbursement of grants to facilitate establishment and growth of micro-business, building sustainable relationships with local authorities, building capacities of young women and men to further develop in social and economic realm of the society contribute to an objective of reaching sustainable systematic solution.

Outcome 1 : Strong and lasting partnerships with the local authorities are established directly influence use of available public resources to provide support to young female and male entrepreneurs In terms of expected results, the Mozaik Foundation continued to build on its foundational efforts to foster entrepreneurship and support young activists through continued collaboration with local authorities. More specifically, 46 Memorandums of Cooperation (MoC)were signed and Mozaik successfully continued the implementation of earlier signed 46 MoC, with all 46 municipalities fulfilling their financial commitments. 132 strategic meetings with carried out with representatives from 50 municipalities. These meetings are aimed at reinforcing partnerships and aligning strategies with local government priorities, directly enhancing the networks and impact. Over 600 000 BAM are awarded for youth projects. Under this outcome the Mozaik foundation worked on Digital Signage deployment in 28 local communities to improve local communication. This led to enhancing direct communication with citizens and beneficiaries. Outcome 2: Strong eco-system for startup entrepreneurship and philanthropy is established within the community lonac.pro with partnerships that create various opportunities for professional success of young women and men. Sticking to expected results Mozaik Foundation worked on improving its online/offline community, initially known as lonac.pro, In February 2024, the community was subjected to strategic rebranding and it is now named Rolify. Apart from rebranding the focus of the community is changed aimed at equipping young people with skills needed for future jobs and leadership roles. This focus highlights Rolify's pivotal role in fostering the development of future leaders and professionals. Rebranding and improving of the platform will lead to over 19,000 of new persons joining and by doing so boasting its membership of more than 100,000 members. Utilizing the Rolify platform, total of 1. 2 million EUR were mobilized in support across businesses, projects, prototypes, initiatives, and other forms of support. Measuring expected results - 200 partners were engaged and Mozaik offered 683 quality opportunities, benefiting 4,991 young individuals. Notably, 26 of these individuals secured internships directly with the Mozaik Foundation, showcasing the effectiveness of strategic partnerships. Following last year´s efforts related to legislative changes to exempt food donations from VAT, over 12,000 BAM has already been donated, significantly enhancing the efficiency and scope of food distribution programs to those in need. Moreover, in terms of outreach, 116 presentations in local communities were organized, informing young people about Youth Bank opportunities, over 360 broadcasts through digital signage solutions in community spaces (28 information points), and 73 events in Startup Studio locations, attended by 1,586 participants. These initiatives not only provide essential information but also foster vital networking opportunities that empower and activate youth across diverse environments. Aiming to have good outreach towards youth, Mozaik applied Plug in Events to maximize benefits but through cost efficiency. Outcome 3: Strategic and operational support Under this outcome as expected results Mozaik and secured additional funding from 35 municipalities for micro-businesses, with support for young entrepreneurs increased from 2,000 BAM to 5,000 BAM. Project managed to increase the interest for micro-business whereby a total of 242 young individuals applied to support their business ideas, leading to 70 new micro-business registrations and the creation of 81 new jobs, including 36 positions (44%) specifically for women. The project also worked on providing new tailored support mechanisms to scale up business. As a result, support of over 47.000 BAM to scale 16 businesses was made utilized. Their operations improved and opportunities to create new job increased demonstrating substantial growth within just six months of entering the market. This achievement highlights the significant impact of tailored support on the sustainability and expansion of micro-business. The YouthBank Board for Micro-business has significantly strengthened its capabilities by welcoming 21 new members, thereby enhancing the boards ability to meet the demand in the local communities by youth entrepreneurs. Furthermore, Mozaik organized three (3) specialized trainings for both new and active members. This education focused on strengthening their skills in assessing social impact and evaluating the environmental effects of business models, ensuring that all approved micro-business applications align with Mozaik´s sustainability and community benefit goals. In this period Moziak supported 108 small youth projects, which were carefully evaluated and approved by more than 320 YouthBank Board members. These projects made significant contributions to local communities, engaging 1,856 volunteersincluding 910 females and 88 volunteers from socially excluded groups (40% of females). The total funding for these initiatives amounted to 285,955 BAM, with contributions from Sida totaling 98,263 BAM and 76,203 BAM provided by municipalities. Additionally, young volunteers successfully raised 110,670 BAM within the local communities, which confirms the effectiveness of the community engagement approach integrated into the program. Mozaik organized and hosted more than 73 free educational programs/events in its Startup Studios across Sarajevo, Biha, and Banja Luka, engaging over 1,586 young individuals, 57% of whom were females. Out of the total number of events, 45 were organized by the youth programs of the Mozaik Foundation (Rolify, Startup studio and Youth Banks). These sessions were also made available online, expanding their reach and deepening their impact on the mobility of entrepreneurs. In terms of unexpected results, this implementation year was a record high in terms of engagement of Youth Bank campaigns for micro-businesses. Mozaik also developed an innovative support system for young entrepreneurs Tech4Impact Fund. This fund is created having recognized the need to provide young entrepreneurs with current business trends, cutting edge technologies. This fund will focus on high-growth and higher -impact start-ups that may be eligible to access financing up to 300 000 BAM from investors.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
